title: Chapter 1130
text:
Recently, the progress of the plot has been a little slow. After all, I'm not a machine. Humans have their ups and downs. Brothers, please bear with me. I'll take a day off tomorrow to adjust.

Currently, the progress is 6/7. The last time I took a day off was in October. I reckon that I won't be able to use up all the 7 days of leave this year.

Actually, every time I'm in a bad state, there will always be people coming out to say that I'm too full of myself or that I'm just being perfunctory. Ever since 2017, there have been people saying that from time to time. Now, it's almost 2020 already. Big bro, every book I write is always like this. When has it ever changed?

The book is already almost 4 million words. The further it goes, the harder it gets to write. My state of mind is getting more and more erratic. This is the same for everyone. Just this chapter, which is neither too long nor too short, caused me to sit from 9: 30 in the morning to 6: 00 in the evening. I'm really stuck. Even in the early stages, I had to endure 2 chapters a day. In 17 years, I suffered from an illness and almost got sent away. At that time, there were people who thought that it was an excuse for me to become a eunuch. They scolded me and were so angry that their tips hurt. The plot is now in the middle to late stages. There are roughly 2 more chapters before it's ready to end. If I'm in a hurry to recuperate, I might not even be able to write 2 chapters. At this stage, what is considered perfunctory? Not writing the details, not caring about the expression, and just pushing out the outline. That's what is called perfunctory. Writing in that way would be much easier for me. I've already planned out the outline, so if I don't write the details, it would be too easy.

Nowadays, to judge an author's ability, the proportion of updates is getting higher and higher. However, updating fast isn't something that most people think. It's something that can be achieved through hard work. This is a skill that needs to be practiced. Some people have talent in this area, and I'm very envious.

My current writing style isn't very popular. Not to mention the low production rate, the quality might not be much better than writing fast. In the future, I will definitely try to change it. I'll turn around and practice my updating speed and brain speed. Who knows, I might really become a beast at 2 chapters or 3 chapters. But at least for now, I'm still unable to change the writing style that I've been used to for the past 5-6 years.
